others.route: Work permit (Labour Commissioner) and residence permit

note: Tanzania: a non-citizen's work permit is applied for through the online system that joins the Labour Commissioner's work permit and the Immigration Department's residence permit; for short work, the Labour Department's Short Term Permit, applied for before entry, is in practice a kind of work permit. The National Arts Council's permit for foreign artists isn't modelled apart. No days without a permit. Read from a law firm's note, since the Immigration Department's pages don't load for this client. The Labour Division's site (kazi.go.tz, read 2026-11-03) says it issues work permits and links the joint online system; the copy of the Non-Citizens (Employment Regulation) Regulations, 2016 it holds leaves the Government Notice's number and date blank, so it isn't held. The Short Term Permit and the no days weren't read on a primary, so the entry stays secondary.

sources.title: Clyde & Co, Work and residence permit application process for investors and other foreign nationals in Tanzania (April 2023)
sources.said: that integrates labour and immigration permits. Once the work permit application has been accepted, the OWAIS forwards the application to the Immigration Department to process a residence permit application. ... An STP is a type of work permit, in practice it is applied at the Labour Department prior to entry of the employee into Tanzania.

sources.title: Prime Minister's Office (Labour, Youth, Employment and Persons with Disability), Labour Division, Tanzania: home page
sources.said: Labour Division is a division under the Prime Minister's Office Labour, Youth, Employment and Persons with Disability, responsible to facilitate conducive working environment for both employers and employees in labour and social security matters and timely issuance of Work Permit services in the Country.
